name: Fax for Agents
tagline: Send and receive faxes from an AI agent
description: Fax for Agents is a fax API, a hosted MCP server and SDKs built so AI agents can send and receive faxes. It is made by JSB Holdings LLC. The server has 15 tools: prepare a document, get a quote, send, poll until the carrier's evidence arrives, and read inbound faxes. A test key is free and uses a sandbox with no carrier. Live sends are prepaid. The same tools are hosted over Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.faxforagents.com/mcp/ with the key as a bearer token.

env.name: FAXFORAGENTS_API_KEY
env.description: Fax for Agents API key. A test key (ffa_test_...) is free and uses the sandbox.

install.notes: Docs: https://faxforagents.com/docs/. The hosted server at https://mcp.faxforagents.com/mcp/ takes the same key as a bearer token.
